facts.summary: Q1 results show cash runway only into Q3 2023, raising going-concern risk · n/a · Trudhesa in migraine · on market

evidence.summary: The Company believes, based on its current operating plan, that it has sufficient capital to fund operations into Q3 2023.
evidence.safety: concomitant use of Trudhesa with triptans and erenumab (a preventive CGRP medication) were well-tolerated with limited treatment-emergent adverse events reported.
